symptom_name_twi: Mogya mmoa tumi firi obi barima/baa mu pii nyinsɛn mu
emergency_action_english: RED FLAG EMERGENCY! Severe bleeding during pregnancy or post-delivery is a critical medical emergency. Proceed IMMEDIATELY to the nearest hospital or district health center.
emergency_action_twi: KƆ ASIBITI NTEMPA! Mogya pii a ɛfiri wo mu nyinsɛn bere mu yɛ hu pa ara. Kɔ ayarsabea a ɛbɛn wo no seesei ara!

symptom_name_twi: Akwadaa kɛseɛ ho yɛ hye pa ara
emergency_action_english: RED FLAG EMERGENCY! High fever in infants under 6 months can signal severe infection or malaria. Do not delay. Seek immediate clinical assessment at the clinic.
emergency_action_twi: NTWƐN KORAA! Abofra a ne ho yɛ hye kyɛn 38.5°C no tumi firi asram (Malaria) anaa yareɛ kɛseɛ. Fa no kɔ asibiti ntɛm!

symptom_name_twi: Tiri yareɛ denden ne ani so a ɛyɛ wusuwusu
emergency_action_english: RED FLAG EMERGENCY! Severe headache with vision changes during pregnancy is a classic sign of Pre-Eclampsia (dangerously high blood pressure). Requires urgent hospital care.
emergency_action_twi: MOGYA MMOROSO HU! Tiri yareɛ denden ne ani so a ɛyɛ wusuwusu nyinsɛn mu kyerɛ sɛ wo mogya aforo kɔ soro pii (Pre-eclampsia). Kɔ asibiti ntem!

symptom_name_twi: Abofra a wosow gu yem mu a ne kɔ so ate ase
emergency_action_english: MODERATE WARNING: Lie down on your left side for 1 hour and count kicks. If you feel fewer than 3 movements in 2 hours, visit the health facility for a fetal heart rate check.
emergency_action_twi: DƆ SI WO BEN KUM ONI MU: Da wo ben kum so dɔnhwerew baako na kan sɛ abofra no bɛwosow mu a. Sɛ abofra no ammwosow dɔnhwerew mmienu mu a, kɔ asibiti.

symptom_name_twi: Anopa ne ho a ɛyɛ no tan anaa ɛfete
emergency_action_english: MILD CONDITION: Common in the first trimester. Sip small amounts of water, eat small frequent meals, and rest. Take prescribed prenatal vitamins.
emergency_action_twi: YAREƐ CHA: Ɛyɛ abodeɛ mu deɛ nyinsɛn hyɛaseɛ mu. Nom nsuo kakra kakra, di aduane feefe, na gye wo ho ahome.

emergency_action_english: MODERATE: Elevate your feet when sitting. Avoid standing for long periods. If swelling suddenly spreads to hands or face, seek urgent blood pressure check.
emergency_action_twi: MANGYE WO NAN SO: Ma wo nan so pɛpɛɛpɛ bere a woti ase. Sɛ nan ne anim hon ntɛm so a, kɔ asibiti kɔyɛ blood pressure examination.
